args.body: Reuse any committed item 4 operator decision. Otherwise, under the existing assignment, use the release binding and verified direct catalogue readback to check the exact draft cited by operator-handoff.md. If the live evidence supports it and the pre-send conditions are met, surface that one copy-ready draft for the authorized operator's send-or-decline decision. If a single unsupported claim can be corrected within the existing offer and authorization, commit the minimal corrected draft and record its hash and verified destination. If the buyer-specific value requires the commissioned revision, record the exact dependency and resume after independently approved deployment is verified. Keep external sending with the authorized operator. Record exposure only from a redacted send receipt and track eligible replies, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

description: The host reports no classified commercial feedback and five unclassified sources.
